title: IB Maths Exam Dates 2027: AA and AI Papers
summary: Check the exact IB Maths exam dates 2027 for AA and AI Papers 1, 2 and 3, with all-zone start times, durations and focused revision advice.
body_markdown:
The **IB Maths exam dates 2027** place AA and AI Paper 1 on Thursday 13 May, Paper 2 on Friday 14 May, and both HL Paper 3 examinations on Tuesday 18 May. Papers 1 and 2 are back-to-back, while HL students have several days before their final mathematics paper.


These dates come from the[final May 2027 examination schedule for zones A, B and C](https://mhsib.weebly.com/uploads/1/3/8/5/138557084/may_2027_final_examination_schedule.pdf) . The schedule provides official sessions rather than one worldwide start time, so students must check their school's examination zone and reporting instructions.


### IB Maths exam dates 2027 at a glance


The following dates apply to **Mathematics: analysis and approaches (AA)** and **Mathematics: applications and interpretation (AI)** .


Date Session Course and paper Level Duration


Thursday 13 May 2027 Afternoon Mathematics AA Paper 1 HL 2 hours


Thursday 13 May 2027 Afternoon Mathematics AA Paper 1 SL 1 hour 30 minutes


Thursday 13 May 2027 Afternoon Mathematics AI Paper 1 HL 2 hours


Thursday 13 May 2027 Afternoon Mathematics AI Paper 1 SL 1 hour 30 minutes


Friday 14 May 2027 Morning Mathematics AA Paper 2 HL 2 hours


Friday 14 May 2027 Morning Mathematics AA Paper 2 SL 1 hour 30 minutes


Friday 14 May 2027 Morning Mathematics AI Paper 2 HL 2 hours


Friday 14 May 2027 Morning Mathematics AI Paper 2 SL 1 hour 30 minutes


Tuesday 18 May 2027 Afternoon Mathematics AA Paper 3 HL only 1 hour 15 minutes


Tuesday 18 May 2027 Afternoon Mathematics AI Paper 3 HL only 1 hour 15 minutes


The **IB Maths AA exam 2027** and **IB Maths AI exam 2027** follow the same dates and sessions, but they remain separate courses with different papers. Confirm that your candidate timetable and examination cover sheet show the correct subject and level.


There is **no Paper 3 at SL** . The HL Paper 3 examinations on 18 May are the final scheduled examinations of the May 2027 session, which runs from Friday 23 April to Tuesday 18 May.


### Local starting times for zones A, B and C


Morning and afternoon sessions begin at different local times according to each school's fixed examination zone. The published schedule states that these times do not require a separate adjustment for daylight saving.


Examination zone Morning session Afternoon session


A12-A9 10:00 14:00


A8 09:30 13:30


A7-A3 09:00 13:00


B3 10:00 14:00


B2 09:30 13:30


B1-B0 09:00 13:00


C-3 10:00 14:00


C-4 09:30 13:30


C-5-C-10 08:30 12:30


For example, a student in zone B2 begins Paper 1 at **13:30 local time** on 13 May and Paper 2 at **09:30 local time** on 14 May. An HL student in that zone begins Paper 3 at 13:30 on 18 May.


These are examination start times, not recommended arrival times. Schools normally ask candidates to report earlier for attendance checks, seating and instructions. Always follow the reporting time issued by your coordinator because an examination cannot be moved for personal convenience without authorization.


### What the schedule means for Papers 1 and 2


Paper 1 takes place on Thursday afternoon, followed by Paper 2 on Friday morning. There may be only an evening between them, depending on your zone and journey, so complete broad syllabus revision before Paper 1.


Under the assessment model used for the 2027 session, **AA Paper 1 is completed without technology** , while AA Paper 2 requires an approved graphing display calculator. AI students use technology extensively, including on Paper 1, reflecting the course's emphasis on modelling, interpretation and technology-supported problem-solving.


The official[AA specimen papers](https://ibo.org/globalassets/new-structure/university-admission/pdfs/dp-mathematics-analysis-and-approaches-specimen-papers-en.pdf) and[AI specimen papers](https://www.ibo.org/globalassets/new-structure/university-admission/pdfs/dp-mathematics-applications-and-interpretation-specimen-papers-en.pdf) demonstrate typical instructions and question styles. Use the final May 2027 timetable, rather than an older specimen paper, to confirm scheduled durations.


### Preparing for back-to-back papers


During the final week, shift from learning whole topics to timed application, error correction and method selection. A practical plan is:


- **Five to seven days before:** Complete one timed Paper 1 and one timed Paper 2 under realistic conditions.
- **Three to four days before:** Classify mistakes as knowledge gaps, algebraic errors, calculator problems or misinterpretations.
- **Two days before:** Practise short sets from weaker topics instead of completing another demanding full paper.
- **The day before:** Review formulas, standard methods, calculator settings and command terms, then stop early enough to sleep properly.
- **After Paper 1:** Eat, hydrate and rest before a short Paper 2 review. Avoid reconstructing every Paper 1 answer with classmates.


For AA Paper 2, practise graphing, numerical equation solving, regression and relevant statistical calculations. For AI, rehearse interpreting calculator output, stating conclusions in context and showing enough working to communicate the mathematical process.


Targeted practice is more useful than random question selection. The[RevisionDojo IB Math AA resource hub](https://www.revisiondojo.com/ib/ib-math-aa) and[IB Math AI resource hub](https://www.revisiondojo.com/ib/ib-math-ai) organize material by course. The guide to[revising IB Math AA and AI effectively](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/how-to-revise-ib-math-aa-and-ai-effectively) explains how to combine recall and examination practice.


### Using the gap before Paper 3


Paper 2 is on Friday morning and **IB Maths Paper 3** is on Tuesday afternoon. The dates are four days apart, with three complete intervening days, plus Tuesday morning. Other subject examinations may occupy part of this period, so plan from your personal timetable rather than assuming the whole interval is free.


A focused HL plan could include:


- **Friday:** Rest, then identify uncertain Paper 3 skills.
- **Saturday:** Complete and mark one timed Paper 3.
- **Sunday:** Rework unsuccessful questions before reviewing the underlying topics.
- **Monday:** Practise extended problems requiring linked reasoning.
- **Tuesday morning:** Check calculator settings, materials and key methods. Do not attempt another full paper.


Paper 3 rewards persistence with unfamiliar, connected problems. Use results established in earlier parts, define variables clearly and continue with valid intermediate answers. Calculator fluency helps, but unexplained output does not replace mathematical reasoning.


For focused recall, use these[IB Math formula flashcard strategies](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/how-to-use-flashcards-to-memorize-math-formulas-fast) . AI students can also adapt the practice cycle in the[IB Math AI self-study resource guide](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/best-ib-math-ai-sl-resources-self-study) .


### Common scheduling mistakes


Avoid assuming that every afternoon examination begins at 14:00. Depending on the zone, the start may be 12:30, 13:00, 13:30 or 14:00. Other common errors include:


- Confusing AA and AI because their papers occur simultaneously.
- Assuming SL students take Paper 3.
- Reading Paper 2 as an afternoon examination when it is in the **morning session** .
- Treating the Paper 3 interval as free without checking other subjects.
- Using an online countdown without checking the final schedule.
- Mistaking the official start time for the required arrival time.


Save your school-issued candidate timetable, including your level, room, reporting instructions and approved access arrangements.


### Conclusion


The main IB Maths exam dates 2027 are **Thursday 13 May for Paper 1** , **Friday 14 May for Paper 2** , and **Tuesday 18 May for HL Paper 3** . Check your examination zone and school reporting time rather than assuming one universal start.


Complete preparation for Papers 1 and 2 before the first examination, then use the longer Paper 3 interval for recovery, timed practice and focused correction. RevisionDojo's AA and AI Study Notes, Questionbank, Flashcards and Mock Exams can support a paper-by-paper revision plan.
